newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - April 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - April 4.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Government finance sector workers start 48-hour warning strike over conditions and to protest against alleged irregular appointment of regional tax official.
- About 120 experts expected at April 21-25 International Fair on Medicine in Africa to be staged in Abidjan.

- U.N. World Food Programme to open regional office in Ivory Coast to serve West Africa, with special emphasis on Liberia, Sierra Leone and Guinea, WFP's regional director Famie Wickens says at meeting with President Henri Konan Bedie.
- Tax collection paralysed by finance workers' strike. - Burkina Faso's Prime Minister Kadre Ouadreago on official visit to Ivory Coast.
- Group of schoolteachers besieges prime minister's office in protest over salary arrears.
- National chamber of Agriculture is about to launch fund to help finance local investment in the sector.
